Question B-001-010-009.

Why the correct answer is right: Test transmissions are permitted when they will not interfere with amateur stations or with other radio services.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "When transmitting in designated sub-bands": Designated sub-bands alone do not make a test acceptable; the interference condition still controls.
- sourceIndex 2: "Only between the hours of midnight and 8:00 AM": The bank does not create a midnight-to-morning testing window, so the time of day is not the permission.
- sourceIndex 3: "After warning other stations who might be interfered with": Warning others is not enough if the test will still interfere; avoiding the interference is the required condition.
